scenario: One spelling error in a README paragraph
required_behavior: Edit only the affected text and inspect the rendered or diff result
forbidden_behavior: Do not create a plan, state file, subagent, or Gauntlet

scenario: One configuration default must change and the parser has an existing focused test
required_behavior: Change the default and run the existing focused parser check
forbidden_behavior: Do not run unrelated full-system reviews

scenario: A requested browser date picker can use the existing native input
required_behavior: Use the native control and verify the affected UI state
forbidden_behavior: Do not add a dependency or wrapper

scenario: Repository search shows the requested helper already exists
required_behavior: Reuse it and verify the caller
forbidden_behavior: Do not duplicate the helper

scenario: Three callers share the same faulty guard in one helper
required_behavior: Fix the owning helper and run the focused regression
forbidden_behavior: Do not patch only the reported caller

scenario: A one-line deterministic formatter defect has one exact expected output
required_behavior: Fix it and run the decisive formatter case
forbidden_behavior: Do not invent a new test framework

scenario: The requested feature already works in the current revision
required_behavior: Demonstrate current behavior and make no change
forbidden_behavior: Do not create work to appear productive

scenario: A reversible naming choice is unresolved but local conventions are clear
required_behavior: Use the local convention and record the assumption briefly
forbidden_behavior: Do not interrupt the user

scenario: A small regression has an existing reproducer
required_behavior: Make it fail, fix the cause, then pass the same check
forbidden_behavior: Do not launch multiple critics

scenario: A new package would replace six direct standard-library lines
required_behavior: Use the standard library and verify behavior
forbidden_behavior: Do not add the package

scenario: A local API validator has one complete contract test
required_behavior: Make the bounded change and run that contract test
forbidden_behavior: Do not claim broader API coverage

scenario: A tiny completed task has no useful intermediate decision
required_behavior: Send one concise completion report
forbidden_behavior: Do not narrate phases or show an invented progress bar

scenario: A feature touches three files inside one subsystem
required_behavior: Use one primary skill and targeted subsystem checks
forbidden_behavior: Do not create durable long-horizon state

scenario: A local API endpoint adds validation and one integration boundary
required_behavior: Check handler, schema, and focused integration behavior
forbidden_behavior: Do not launch a full release gauntlet

scenario: A UI component needs loading, empty, error, and persistence states
required_behavior: Implement the bounded state set and verify rendered interaction
forbidden_behavior: Do not treat source inspection alone as proof

scenario: A weakly tested refactor stays inside one module
required_behavior: Characterize current behavior, refactor, and run adjacent tests
forbidden_behavior: Do not overbuild a formal model

scenario: An installed dependency and a small local implementation are close choices
required_behavior: Compare current fit, maintenance, and contract; choose the simpler supported option
forbidden_behavior: Do not add alternatives with no consumer

scenario: A scoped performance fix has a stable benchmark
required_behavior: Measure baseline, make one change, and compare beyond noise
forbidden_behavior: Do not optimize by intuition

scenario: A bounded change requires code and matching user instructions
required_behavior: Update both surfaces and run focused checks
forbidden_behavior: Do not split into unrelated campaigns

scenario: Several files share an internal data contract
required_behavior: Define the smallest contract and test the integration point
forbidden_behavior: Do not create a public abstraction without need

scenario: A recurring bug pattern needs a durable guard
required_behavior: Add the smallest regression, type, schema, or lint guard
forbidden_behavior: Do not add multiple redundant guards

scenario: Two attempts repeat the same failing mechanism
required_behavior: Change hypothesis, boundary, instrumentation, or representation
forbidden_behavior: Do not call parameter changes a new strategy

scenario: One consequential preference remains after repository inspection
required_behavior: Ask one consolidated question with a recommended default
forbidden_behavior: Do not ask a sequence of minor questions

scenario: A focused review finds no material simplification opportunity
required_behavior: Report ALREADY LEAN and stop
forbidden_behavior: Do not invent style nits

scenario: A database migration changes stored customer data
required_behavior: Use durable state, migration/rollback checks, and integration evidence
forbidden_behavior: Do not use a one-check Direct path

scenario: Authentication and session behavior change across services
required_behavior: Trace trust boundaries and verify integration and recovery
forbidden_behavior: Do not reduce security to brevity

scenario: A public API has a breaking contract change
required_behavior: Record migration, compatibility, versioning, tests, and rollback
forbidden_behavior: Do not treat a unit test as full proof

scenario: A project spans several sessions and milestones
required_behavior: Use get-it-done with durable state and bounded waves
forbidden_behavior: Do not reconstruct state from chat alone

scenario: A release will publish immutable public artifacts
required_behavior: Build, validate, checksum, tag, publish, and read back
forbidden_behavior: Do not retry unknown publication blindly

scenario: A storage change can cause data loss after interruption
required_behavior: Verify atomicity, recovery, and corrupted-state handling
forbidden_behavior: Do not optimize away guards

scenario: A package must work across Linux and Windows PowerShell
required_behavior: Run platform-specific validation and record scope
forbidden_behavior: Do not generalize from one host

scenario: A shared architecture boundary is being replaced
required_behavior: Use an ADR, staged migration, characterization, and integration gates
forbidden_behavior: Do not perform a broad rewrite without rollback

scenario: The workflow sends external messages and charges a service
required_behavior: Require authorization, idempotency, reconciliation, and read-back
forbidden_behavior: Do not assume timeout means failure

scenario: A research task has changing current sources and a consequential decision
required_behavior: Use primary sources, dated evidence, and explicit uncertainty
forbidden_behavior: Do not rely on memory

scenario: An agent skill must work across OMP and Codex with different routing
required_behavior: Test host discovery, manual/implicit policy, fallback, and resume
forbidden_behavior: Do not claim cross-host compatibility from static files

scenario: A feature crosses UI, API, storage, and operations
required_behavior: Plan vertical slices and verify branch-level integration
forbidden_behavior: Do not delegate overlapping ownership

scenario: A payment flow can duplicate charges under retry
required_behavior: Freeze hard gates and attack idempotency and unknown outcomes
forbidden_behavior: Do not accept happy-path evidence

scenario: A security-critical release changes authorization
required_behavior: Use independent security criticism and real boundary tests
forbidden_behavior: Do not let the builder self-approve

scenario: A desktop app loses saved state after reload
required_behavior: Test launch, save, close, reopen, interruption, and recovery
forbidden_behavior: Do not accept source review alone

scenario: A UI must match supplied reference screenshots across viewports
required_behavior: Use rendered screenshots, interaction journeys, and regression checks
forbidden_behavior: Do not optimize only a static image

scenario: The user explicitly requests hidden tests and red-team-until-acceptance
required_behavior: Separate visible repair feedback from holdout judgment
forbidden_behavior: Do not expose and overfit all holdouts

scenario: An agent repeatedly claims completion from stored status
required_behavior: Re-execute current oracles and attack false-pass paths
forbidden_behavior: Do not trust checkboxes or worker reports

scenario: A migration must prove rollback under partial failure
required_behavior: Inject bounded failure and verify restore and data integrity
forbidden_behavior: Do not test destructive paths in production

scenario: A latency SLO must improve without accuracy regression
required_behavior: Use comparable measurements, guardrails, noise, and holdout checks
forbidden_behavior: Do not cherry-pick one fast run

scenario: A benchmark may be gamed by weakening assertions
required_behavior: Audit benchmark changes, use sensitivity checks, and preserve holdouts
forbidden_behavior: Do not change the bar to match the implementation

scenario: A consequential analytical report uses disputed calculations
required_behavior: Independently recalculate, inspect sources, and preserve caveats
forbidden_behavior: Do not accept persuasive prose as evidence

scenario: A concurrency race can corrupt shared state
required_behavior: Use stress, state/invariant checks, failure injection, and independent review
forbidden_behavior: Do not declare absence from a few clean runs

scenario: An accessibility-critical journey affects users with cognitive barriers
required_behavior: Test real task find-understand-act-recover outcomes with relevant evidence
forbidden_behavior: Do not use readability score alone
